name: Dikie Angely
source:
A criminal gang of five young guys appeared in modern Russia, which became unexpectedly successful and elusive.

 All bandits have completely different points of view and life stories, but they are united by a common goal - to "earn" as much money as possible through risky and reckless actions.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2658780/]Steam[/url]]
